activation_policy: QR code by email, installs in about 30 seconds. The validity clock starts when the eSIM first connects to a network in the destination, not when you buy it. No ID check and no store visit. Data roaming has to be switched on.
fair_use_policy: Unlimited plans are sold as a daily high-speed allowance you choose at checkout - 500MB, 1GB, 2GB, 3GB, 5GB or 10GB a day. Past that the speed drops to between 500Kbps and 1Mbps for the rest of the day, and stays unlimited. The choice changes the price.
device_compatibility: Any eSIM-capable iPhone or Android handset, carrier-unlocked. Hotspot is allowed.
notes: Also sells a VPN add-on and a separate phone-number product, which is why a handful of plans show voice and SMS.
Site lists EE, O2 and Three (H3G). Breakout IP is France, Netherlands or UK, so some UK services may see a non-UK IP. Cheapest unlimited seen on 7 Sep 2026: $6.12 for 3 days at 3GB/day.
